description: How well plasmacytoid dendritic cells present antigen to naive CD4 T cells is debated. Human cells matured by virus drive naive CD4 T cells to make IFN-γ and IL-10 in culture, and in mice plasmacytoid cells loaded with antigen primed naive CD4 T cells in lymph nodes but not in the spleen. Some earlier reports of T-cell priming may come from look-alike cells in the same gate, and in mice only plasmacytoid cells of myeloid origin present antigen well.
